$comment: P16a post text templates. A target may carry kinds.montage / kinds.won-reel text overrides (D301); a clip (kind short) uses the base text. youtube-video is the target for finished videos that are not Shorts (horizontal, or longer than the Shorts limit in limits.json). Placeholders only: {handles.x}, {links.x} come from the local profile (data/profile.local.json) at export time; {date} is the stream date (UTC, from candidates.json recordStartUtc); {n} is the clip's rank in the run. Never put names, brands or channel ids here. Chat text, viewer names, marker notes and candidate reasons are never used in post text.

youtube-shorts.title: Stream highlight {n} ({date})

montage.title: Stream kill montage {n} ({date})

won-reel.title: Stream victory reel {n} ({date})
